title: "Mendelian randomization of plasma metabolites and sleep traits"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: show
---

This document integrates all numbered scripts in the former **MR** folder. Run the chunks in order. The only user-specific input is `project_root`: replace the placeholder `"Path"` once in the setup chunk. Input files are read from the relative data subfolders, while all results are written to `MR/outputs`.

## Integrated setup and relative paths

```{r mr-00-setup, include=FALSE}
# Source file: 1_circulation_metabolites_and_sleep_mr.Rmd / integrated setup
# Integrated setup shared by every chunk.
project_root <- normalizePath("Path", winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)

data_dir               <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
metabolite_gwas_dir    <- file.path(data_dir, "Metabolite_GWAS")
sleep_gwas_dir         <- file.path(data_dir, "Sleep_GWAS")
reference_dir          <- file.path(data_dir, "Reference")
ld_bfile               <- file.path(data_dir, "LD_Reference", "EUR")
phenoscanner_dir       <- file.path(data_dir, "PhenoScanner")

code_dir               <- file.path(project_root, "MetaboliteSleep_Code")
mr_code_dir            <- file.path(code_dir, "MR")
repeat_code_dir        <- file.path(code_dir, "RepeatMR")
coloc_code_dir         <- file.path(code_dir, "Colocalization")
mr_output_dir          <- file.path(mr_code_dir, "outputs")
repeat_output_dir      <- file.path(repeat_code_dir, "outputs")
coloc_output_dir       <- file.path(coloc_code_dir, "outputs")

dir.create(mr_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (d in c("clump_data", "harmonise_data", "mr_res", "Fisher's test")) {
  dir.create(file.path(mr_output_dir, d), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

catalog_file            <- file.path(reference_dir, "gwas_catalog_summary_statistics_table_export.tsv")
sleep_trait_file        <- file.path(reference_dir, "GWAS_sleep_trait.xlsx")

# Resolve paths stored in the sleep metadata workbook. Existing absolute paths
# are used when present; otherwise the file is located by basename under Data/Sleep_GWAS.
resolve_sleep_resource <- function(path_value) {
  path_value <- as.character(path_value)
  if (file.exists(path_value)) return(normalizePath(path_value, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
  hits <- list.files(sleep_gwas_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  hits <- hits[basename(hits) == basename(path_value)]
  if (length(hits) == 1L) return(normalizePath(hits, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
  if (length(hits) == 0L) stop("Sleep-GWAS resource not found under Data/Sleep_GWAS: ", basename(path_value))
  stop("More than one matching sleep-GWAS resource was found: ", paste(basename(hits), collapse = ", "))
}

pathway_file            <- file.path(reference_dir, "20231120_metabolite_pathway.xlsx")
hmdb_file               <- file.path(reference_dir, "20231121_1091metabolite_HMDBID.xlsx")
ultimate_trait_file     <- file.path(reference_dir, "20240322_metabolite_id_ulttrait.xlsx")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)
  library(readxl)
  library(openxlsx)
  library(TwoSampleMR)
  library(plinkbinr)
  library(ieugwasr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(mr.raps)
})
```

## 1. Metabolites as exposure and sleep traits as outcome

```{r mr-01-01-prepare-data}

row_file<-data.frame(gwas_id=NA,sleep_type=NA,all_row=NA,p5e6_row=NA,p5e8_row=NA,format_row=NA,clump1_row=NA,clump2_row=NA,clump3_row=NA,harmonise1_row=NA,harmonise2_row=NA,harmonise3_row=NA)
```

```{r mr-01-02-harmonise-metabolites-to-sleep}
# Source file: 1_circulation_metabolites_and_sleep_mr.Rmd
r<-0
for (id in c(start_id:end_id)) {
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  #all_snp
  metabolite<-fread(paste(file_dir,"GCST",id,".tsv.gz",sep = ""))
  row_file[["gwas_id"]][r]<-id
  row_file[["all_row"]][r]<-nrow(metabolite)
  #pselect5e6
  metabolite_p5e6<-subset(metabolite,p_value<5e-6)
  row_file[["p5e6_row"]][r]<-nrow(metabolite_p5e6)
  
  #pselect5e8
  metabolite_p5e8<-subset(metabolite,p_value<5e-8)
  row_file[["p5e8_row"]][r]<-nrow(metabolite_p5e8)
  if(nrow(metabolite_p5e8)==0){
    r<-r+1
    row_file[r,] <- NA
    next
  }
  
  if(nrow(metabolite_p5e8)==1 & is.na(metabolite_p5e8[["variant_id"]][1])){
    r<-r+1
    row_file[r,] <- NA
    next
  }
  
  #format
  metabolite_format<-format_data(metabolite_p5e8,
                                 type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                                 snp_col = "variant_id",chr_col = "chromosome",
                                 pos_col = "base_pair_location",
                                 effect_allele_col = "effect_allele",
                                 other_allele_col = "other_allele",beta_col = "beta",
                                 se_col = "standard_error",
                                 eaf_col = "effect_allele_frequency",
                                 pval_col = "p_value")
  metabolite_format$exposure<-id
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(metabolite_format)
  
  #clump
  metabolite_clump_temp<-metabolite_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- metabolite_clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  metabolite_sleep_clump1 <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 1000,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.1,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = ld_bfile) %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump1_row"]][r]<-length(metabolite_sleep_clump1)
  clump1 <- subset(metabolite_format, SNP %in% metabolite_sleep_clump1)
  
  metabolite_sleep_clump2 <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 1000,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.01,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = ld_bfile) %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump2_row"]][r]<-length(metabolite_sleep_clump2)
  clump2 <- subset(metabolite_format, SNP %in% metabolite_sleep_clump2)
  
  metabolite_sleep_clump3 <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 10000,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.001,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = ld_bfile) %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump3_row"]][r]<-length(metabolite_sleep_clump3)
  clump3 <- subset(metabolite_format, SNP %in% metabolite_sleep_clump3)
  
  save(clump1,file = file.path(paste("clump_data/",
                                      id,"_clump1.RData",sep = "")))
  save(clump2,file = file.path(paste("clump_data/",
                                      id,"_clump2.RData",sep = "")))
  save(clump3,file = file.path(paste("clump_data/",
                                      id,"_clump3.RData",sep = "")))
  

  for (i in 1:dim(sleep_table)[1]) {
    load(file = resolve_sleep_resource(sleep_table[i, 'local_allSNP_path']))
    if(sleep_table[i,'trait']=="napping"|sleep_table[i,'trait']=="morning_person"|
       sleep_table[i,'trait']=="chronotype"){
      out_allSNP <- dat_allSNP_hg19
      rm(dat_allSNP_hg19)
      setnames(out_allSNP,"EAF","FREQ")
    }
    else{
      out_allSNP <- get(paste(sleep_table[i,'trait'],"allSNP",sep = "_"))
      rm(list = paste(sleep_table[i,'trait'],"allSNP",sep = "_"))
    }
    row_file[["sleep_type"]][r]<-as.character(sleep_table[i,'trait'])
    
    
    #outcome
    out1<-tryCatch({
      format_data(out_allSNP,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump1$SNP,snp_col = "SNP",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "FREQ")
    }, error=function(e) {})
    if(length(out1)!=0)
      out1$outcome<-as.character(sleep_table[i,'trait']) 
    
    out2<-tryCatch({
      format_data(out_allSNP,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump2$SNP,snp_col = "SNP",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "FREQ")
    }, error=function(e) {})
    if(length(out2)!=0)
      out2$outcome<-as.character(sleep_table[i,'trait'])
    
    out3<-tryCatch({
      format_data(out_allSNP,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump3$SNP,snp_col = "SNP",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "FREQ")
    }, error=function(e) {})
    if(length(out3)!=0)
      out3$outcome<-as.character(sleep_table[i,'trait'])
    
    if(length(out1)==0|length(out2)==0|length(out3)==0){
      row_file[["harmonise1_row"]][r]<-0
      row_file[["harmonise2_row"]][r]<-0
      row_file[["harmonise3_row"]][r]<-0
      r<-r+1
      row_file[r,] <- NA
      next
    }
    
    #harmonise
    exp_out_har1<-harmonise_data(clump1,out1,action = 2)
    row_file[["harmonise1_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har1)
    exp_out_har2<-harmonise_data(clump2,out2,action = 2)
    row_file[["harmonise2_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har2)
    exp_out_har3<-harmonise_data(clump3,out3,action = 2)
    row_file[["harmonise3_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har3)
    
    save(exp_out_har1,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_har1.RData",sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har1,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_har1.csv",sep = "")))
    save(exp_out_har2,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_har2.RData",sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har2,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_har2.csv",sep = "")))
    save(exp_out_har3,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_har3.RData",sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har3,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_har3.csv",sep = "")))
    
    save(exp_out_har1,exp_out_har2,exp_out_har3,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_har.RData",sep = "")))
  
    r<-r+1
    row_file[r,] <- NA
  }
}

#save file
write.csv(row_file,file = file.path("metabolite_sleep_all_p5e8_format_clump_har_row.csv"),row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r mr-01-03-run-metabolite-sleep-mr}
# Source file: 1_circulation_metabolites_and_sleep_mr.Rmd
combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)

start_id = 90199621
end_id = 90201020

sleep_table<-read_excel(sleep_trait_file,sheet = "sleep_trait_out")

for (id in c(start_id:end_id)) {
  for (i in 1:dim(sleep_table)[1]) {
    if(file.exists(paste("harmonise_data/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                         "_har.RData",sep = ""))){
      folder_path<-paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",sep = "")
      dir.create(folder_path)
    
      load(paste("harmonise_data/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_har.RData",sep = ""))
    }
    else next
    
    ##har1_mr
    #MR with default method=deft
    if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har1,mr_keep==TRUE))>1){
    exp_out_har1_mrdeft<-mr(exp_out_har1,method_list=                               
                              c("mr_ivw","mr_egger_regression","mr_weighted_median"))
    exp_out_har1_mrhet<-mr_heterogeneity(exp_out_har1)
    exp_out_har1_mrplt<-mr_pleiotropy_test(exp_out_har1)
    exp_out_har1_mrsin<-mr_singlesnp(exp_out_har1)
    exp_out_har1_mrloo<-mr_leaveoneout(exp_out_har1)

    #plots
    exp_out_har1_scatP<-mr_scatter_plot(exp_out_har1_mrdeft,exp_out_har1)
    exp_out_har1_scatP

           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har1_scatP.pdf",sep = "")))

    exp_out_har1_sinP<-mr_forest_plot(exp_out_har1_mrsin)
    exp_out_har1_sinP
    ggsave(exp_out_har1_sinP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har1_sinP.pdf",sep = "")))

    exp_out_har1_looP<-mr_leaveoneout_plot(exp_out_har1_mrloo)
    exp_out_har1_looP
    ggsave(exp_out_har1_looP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har1_looP.pdf",sep = "")))

    exp_out_har1_funnelP<-mr_funnel_plot(exp_out_har1_mrsin)
    exp_out_har1_funnelP
    ggsave(exp_out_har1_funnelP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/",id,"_",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"/",id,"_",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har1_funnelP.pdf",sep = "")))

    #combine_all_mrresults 
    exp_out_har1_mrallres<-combine_all_mrresults(res = exp_out_har1_mrdeft, 
                                           het= exp_out_har1_mrhet,
                                           plt =exp_out_har1_mrplt,
                                           sin = exp_out_har1_mrsin,

    write.csv(exp_out_har1_mrallres,file =

                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],
                                "_har1_mr_allres.csv",sep = "")))

    ##subset for rbind
    exp_out_har1_mrsubres<-exp_out_har1_mrallres[-which(exp_out_har1_mrallres$Method==
                                                          "Wald ratio"),]
    exp_out_har1_mrsubres<-exp_out_har1_mrsubres[,c("Method","outcome","exposure",                              "nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept",                                   "intercept_se","intercept_pval","id.outcome","id.exposure")]
    write.csv(exp_out_har1_mrsubres,file =

                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],

    #add mr.raps for weak instrumental

    ##transform list to data.frame
    exp_out_har1_mrraps_re<-as.data.frame(exp_out_har1_mrraps)

                                "_har1_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
    }else if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har1,mr_keep==TRUE))==1){
        exp_out_har1_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,                 b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)
      exp_out_har1_mrdeft<-mr(exp_out_har1)
```

## 2. Sleep traits as exposure and metabolites as outcome

```{r mr-02-01-prepare-data}
# Source file: 2_circulation_sleep_and_metabolites_mr.Rmd
file_dir <- metabolite_gwas_dir

sleep_table<-read_excel(sleep_trait_file,sheet = "sleep_trait_exp")

row_file<-data.frame(out_gwas_id=NA,out_all_row=NA,sleep_type=NA,clump1_row=NA,clump2_row=NA,clump3_row=NA,harmonise1_row=NA,harmonise2_row=NA,harmonise3_row=NA)

start_id = 90199621
end_id = 90201020
```

```{r mr-02-02-format-clump-sleep-exposures}
# Source file: 2_circulation_sleep_and_metabolites_mr.Rmd
for (i in 1:dim(sleep_table)[1]) {
    load(file = resolve_sleep_resource(sleep_table[i, 'local_pselect_path']))
    pselectdat<-dat_p5e8_hg19
    rm(dat_p5e8_hg19)
    
    #format
    sleep_format<-format_data(pselectdat,type = "exposure",header = TRUE,
                      snps = NULL,snp_col = "SNP",
                      pos_col = "BP",chr_col = "CHR",
                      effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                      other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",beta_col = "BETA",
                      se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P",eaf_col = "EAF")
    sleep_format$exposure<-as.character(sleep_table[i,'trait'])
    
    #clump
    sleep_clump_temp<-sleep_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
    pre_clump_data <- sleep_clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
    
    sleep_metabolite_clump1 <- ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                                        clump_kb = 1000,  
                                        clump_r2 = 0.1,  
                                        clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                                        plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                                        bfile = ld_bfile) %>% {.$rsid}
    clump1 <- subset(sleep_format, SNP %in% sleep_metabolite_clump1)
      
    sleep_metabolite_clump2 <- ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                                        clump_kb = 1000,  
                                        clump_r2 = 0.01,  
                                        clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                                        plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                                        bfile = ld_bfile) %>% {.$rsid}
    clump2 <- subset(sleep_format, SNP %in% sleep_metabolite_clump2)
      
    sleep_metabolite_clump3 <- ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                                        clump_kb = 10000,  
                                        clump_r2 = 0.001,  
                                        clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                                        plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                                        bfile = ld_bfile) %>% {.$rsid}
    clump3 <- subset(sleep_format, SNP %in% sleep_metabolite_clump3)
    
    save(clump1,file = file.path(paste("clump_data/",
                                      sleep_table[i,"trait"],"_clump1.RData",sep = "")))
    save(clump2,file = file.path(paste("clump_data/",
                                      sleep_table[i,"trait"],"_clump2.RData",sep = "")))
    save(clump3,file = file.path(paste("clump_data/",
                                      sleep_table[i,"trait"],"_clump3.RData",sep = "")))
}
```

```{r mr-02-03-harmonise-sleep-to-metabolites}
# Source file: 2_circulation_sleep_and_metabolites_mr.Rmd
r<-0
for (id in start_id:end_id) {
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  
  #all_snp
  metabolite<-fread(paste(file_dir,"GCST",id,".tsv.gz",sep = ""))
  row_file[["out_gwas_id"]][r]<-id
  row_file[["out_all_row"]][r]<-nrow(metabolite)
  
  #sleep for pselect
  for (i in 1:dim(sleep_table)[1]) {
    load(file = as.character(paste("clump_data/",
                                      sleep_table[i,"trait"],"_clump1.RData",sep = "")))
    load(file = as.character(paste("clump_data/",
                                      sleep_table[i,"trait"],"_clump2.RData",sep = "")))
    load(file = as.character(paste("clump_data/",
                                      sleep_table[i,"trait"],"_clump3.RData",sep = "")))
    
    row_file[["sleep_type"]][r]<-as.character(sleep_table[i,"trait"])
    
    #outcome
    out1<-format_data(metabolite,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,snps = clump1$SNP,
                                 snp_col = "variant_id",chr_col = "chromosome",
                                 pos_col = "base_pair_location",
                                 effect_allele_col = "effect_allele",
                                 other_allele_col = "other_allele",beta_col = "beta",
                                 se_col = "standard_error",
                                 eaf_col = "effect_allele_frequency",
                                 pval_col = "p_value")
    out1$outcome<-id
    
    out2<-format_data(metabolite,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,snps = clump2$SNP,
                                 snp_col = "variant_id",chr_col = "chromosome",
                                 pos_col = "base_pair_location",
                                 effect_allele_col = "effect_allele",
                                 other_allele_col = "other_allele",beta_col = "beta",
                                 se_col = "standard_error",
                                 eaf_col = "effect_allele_frequency",
                                 pval_col = "p_value")
    out2$outcome<-id
    
    out3<-format_data(metabolite,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,snps = clump3$SNP,
                                 snp_col = "variant_id",chr_col = "chromosome",
                                 pos_col = "base_pair_location",
                                 effect_allele_col = "effect_allele",
                                 other_allele_col = "other_allele",beta_col = "beta",
                                 se_col = "standard_error",
                                 eaf_col = "effect_allele_frequency",
                                 pval_col = "p_value")
    out3$outcome<-id
    
    
    #harmonise
    exp_out_har1<-harmonise_data(clump1,out1,action = 2)
    row_file[["harmonise1_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har1)
    exp_out_har2<-harmonise_data(clump2,out2,action = 2)
    row_file[["harmonise2_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har2)
    exp_out_har3<-harmonise_data(clump3,out3,action = 2)
    row_file[["harmonise3_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har3)
    
    save(exp_out_har1,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,"_har1.RData",sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har1,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,"_har1.csv",sep = "")))
    save(exp_out_har2,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,"_har2.RData",sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har2,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,"_har2.csv",sep = "")))
    save(exp_out_har3,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,"_har3.RData",sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har3,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,"_har3.csv",sep = "")))
    
    save(exp_out_har1,exp_out_har2,exp_out_har3,file = file.path(paste("harmonise_data/",
                             sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,"_har.RData",sep = "")))
  
    r<-r+1
    row_file[r,] <- NA
  }
}
```

```{r mr-02-04-run-sleep-metabolite-mr}
# Source file: 2_circulation_sleep_and_metabolites_mr.Rmd
combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

    write.csv(exp_out_har3_mrraps,file= 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,"/",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,
                                "_har3_mr_rapsres.csv",sep = "")))

    ##transform list to data.frame
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re<-as.data.frame(exp_out_har3_mrraps)

    ##rename colnames to merge
    setnames(exp_out_har3_mrraps_re,c("beta.hat","beta.se","beta.p.value"),
             c("b","se","pval"))
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$Method<-"MR RAPS"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$outcome<-as.character(id)
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$exposure<-as.character(sleep_table[i,'trait'])
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$nsnp<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$Q<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$Q_df<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$Q_pval<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$intercept<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$intercept_se<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$intercept_pval<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$id.outcome<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re$id.exposure<-"NA"
    exp_out_har3_mrraps_re<-exp_out_har3_mrraps_re[,c("Method","outcome","exposure",                       "nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept","intercept_se",                                             "intercept_pval","id.outcome","id.exposure")]

    #rbind mr results
    exp_out_har3_mr_bindres<-rbind(exp_out_har3_mrsubres,exp_out_har3_mrraps_re)
    exp_out_har3_mr_bindres$exp_out_har_pair=as.character(paste(                                                           sleep_table[i,'trait'],id,"har3",sep = "_"))
    write.csv(exp_out_har3_mr_bindres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,"/",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,
                                "_har3_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
    }
    else{
      exp_out_har3_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,                 b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)
    }
    
    
    ##bind all for each pair
    all_mr_bindres<-rbind(exp_out_har1_mr_bindres,exp_out_har2_mr_bindres,
                          exp_out_har3_mr_bindres)
    write.csv(all_mr_bindres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,"/",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,
                                "_har_mr_bindres.csv",sep = "")))
    save.image(file = file.path(paste("mr_res/",sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,"/",
                                sleep_table[i,'trait'],"_",id,
                                "_har_mr_bindres.RData",sep = "")))
    
    ##bind all
    all_res<-rbind(all_res,all_mr_bindres)
  }
}

#save all_res
all_res<-all_res[-1,]
write.csv(all_res,file = file.path(paste("mr_res/sleep_metabolite_mr_bindres.csv",
                                         sep = "")))
```

```{r mr-03-04-select-har3-and-apply-fdr}
# Source file: 3_FDR_metabolite_sleep_table.Rmd
# Select results from the third harmonization scheme (har3)
all_res_pathway$har<- sapply(all_res_pathway$exp_out_har_pair,function(x){
        temp <- lapply(strsplit(x, split = "_"), tail , 1 )
				return(as.character(temp))	
				})
all_res_pathway<-subset(all_res_pathway,all_res_pathway$har=="har3")

# Rename columns and remove spaces from column names
all_res_pathway<-setnames(all_res_pathway,c("super pathway","sub pathway","gene for shared protein","protein names"),c("super_pathway","sub_pathway","gene_shared_protein","protein_names"))

# Add analysis columns required for later merging
all_res_pathway<-data.frame(all_res_pathway,pfdr_method=NA,pfdr_sleepmethod=NA,pbof_method=NA,pbof_sleepmethod=NA)

all_res_pathway<-subset(all_res_pathway,all_res_pathway$outcome!="AHI")
all_res_pathway<-subset(all_res_pathway,all_res_pathway$outcome!="daytimesleepiness")
all_res_pathway<-subset(all_res_pathway,all_res_pathway$outcome!="snoringMain")

# Initialize an empty result table
all_res_fdr<-data.frame(Method=NA,exposure=NA,reportedTrait=NA,outcome=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,pfdr_method=NA,pfdr_sleepmethod=NA,pbof_method=NA,pbof_sleepmethod=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,id.exposure=NA,id.outcome=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA,super_pathway=NA,sub_pathway=NA,gene_shared_protein=NA,protein_names=NA,har=NA)

# Apply multiple-testing correction in a loop
  for (mtd in c("Inverse variance weighted","MR Egger","Weighted median","MR RAPS")) {
    
    if(mtd=="Inverse variance weighted"){
      temp<-subset(all_res_pathway, Method == "Wald ratio")
      temp_1mtd<- subset(all_res_pathway, Method == mtd)
      temp_1mtd<-rbind(temp_1mtd,temp)
    }else{
      temp_1mtd<- subset(all_res_pathway, Method == mtd)
    }
    
    #bonfferoni
    if(nrow(subset(temp_1mtd,temp_1mtd$pval<0.05/length(temp_1mtd$pval)))>0){
      a<-subset(temp_1mtd,temp_1mtd$pval<0.05/length(temp_1mtd$pval))
      a$pbof_method<-0.05/length(temp_1mtd$pval)
      b<-subset(temp_1mtd,temp_1mtd$pval>=0.05/length(temp_1mtd$pval))
      b$pbof_method<-"/"
      temp_1mtd<-rbind(a,b)
    }else{
      temp_1mtd$pbof_method<-"/"
    }
    
    #fdr
    temp_1mtd$pfdr_method<-p.adjust(temp_1mtd$pval,method = "fdr",
                                   n = length(temp_1mtd$pval))
    
    #bind
    all_res_fdr<-rbind(all_res_fdr,temp_1mtd)
  }

all_res_fdr<-all_res_fdr[-1,]
all_res<-all_res_fdr
all_res_fdr<-data.frame(Method=NA,exposure=NA,reportedTrait=NA,outcome=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,pfdr_method=NA,pfdr_sleepmethod=NA,pbof_method=NA,pbof_sleepmethod=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,id.exposure=NA,id.outcome=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA,super_pathway=NA,sub_pathway=NA,gene_shared_protein=NA,protein_names=NA,har=NA)

for (sleep in c("OSA","daytimesleepiness_adjBMI","sleepduration","longsleepduration","shortsleepduration","insomnia","snoringadjBMI","chronotype","morning_person","napping")) {
  for (mtd in c("Inverse variance weighted","MR Egger","Weighted median","MR RAPS")) {
    temp_1slp_1mtd<- subset(all_res, outcome == sleep)
    if(mtd=="Inverse variance weighted"){
      temp<-subset(temp_1slp_1mtd, Method == "Wald ratio")
      temp_1slp_1mtd<- subset(temp_1slp_1mtd, Method == mtd)
      temp_1slp_1mtd<-rbind(temp_1slp_1mtd,temp)
    }else{
      temp_1slp_1mtd<- subset(temp_1slp_1mtd, Method == mtd)
    }
    
    #bonfferoni
    if(nrow(subset(temp_1slp_1mtd,temp_1slp_1mtd$pval<
                   0.05/length(temp_1slp_1mtd$pval)))>0){
      a<-subset(temp_1slp_1mtd,temp_1slp_1mtd$pval<0.05/length(temp_1slp_1mtd$pval))
      a$pbof_sleepmethod<-0.05/length(temp_1slp_1mtd$pval)
      b<-subset(temp_1slp_1mtd,temp_1slp_1mtd$pval>=0.05/length(temp_1slp_1mtd$pval))
      b$pbof_sleepmethod<-"/"
      temp_1slp_1mtd<-rbind(a,b)
    }else{
      temp_1slp_1mtd$pbof_sleepmethod<-"/"
    }
    
    #fdr
    temp_1slp_1mtd$pfdr_sleepmethod<-p.adjust(temp_1slp_1mtd$pval,method = "fdr",
                                   n = length(temp_1slp_1mtd$pval))
    
    #bind
    all_res_fdr<-rbind(all_res_fdr,temp_1slp_1mtd)
    }
}

all_res_fdr<-all_res_fdr[-1,]
all_res<-all_res_fdr
```

```{r mr-03-05-bind-hmdb-and-ultimate-traits}

metabolite_HMDBID<-read_excel(hmdb_file, sheet = "Sheet1")

all_res$metabolite<-gsub('[-]','',all_res$metabolite)
all_res$metabolite<-gsub(' ','',all_res$metabolite)

metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite<-gsub("[(.*)]","",metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite)
metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite<-gsub('[*]','',metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite)
metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite<-gsub('[/]','to',metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite)
metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite<-gsub('[-]','',metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite)

metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite<-gsub(' ','',metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite)

metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite<-tolower(metabolite_HMDBID$metabolite)
all_res$metabolite<-tolower(all_res$metabolite)

all_res_HMDBID<-merge(all_res,metabolite_HMDBID,by="metabolite",all.x = TRUE)
# Remove the temporary metabolite key column
all_res_HMDBID<-all_res_HMDBID[,-which(colnames(all_res_HMDBID) == "metabolite")]

# Add the original metabolite names
metabolite_ulttrait<-read_excel(ultimate_trait_file, sheet = "Sheet 1")

metabolite_ulttrait$ult_trait<-sub("(.)","\\U\\1",metabolite_ulttrait$ult_trait,perl=TRUE)

all_res_HMDBID<-merge(all_res_HMDBID,metabolite_ulttrait,by="exposure")

# Sort by metabolite, sleep trait, and MR method
# Initialize an empty result table
all_res_ult<-data.frame(Method=NA,exposure=NA,reportedTrait=NA,outcome=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,pfdr_method=NA,pfdr_sleepmethod=NA,pbof_method=NA,pbof_sleepmethod=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,id.exposure=NA,id.outcome=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA,super_pathway=NA,sub_pathway=NA,gene_shared_protein=NA,protein_names=NA,har=NA,ult_trait=NA,HMDB_curated=NA)

for (id in sort(unique(all_res$exposure))) {
  temp<-subset(all_res_HMDBID,all_res_HMDBID$exposure==id)
  for (sl in unique(all_res$outcome)) {
    temp1<-subset(temp,temp$outcome==sl)
    for (mt in unique(all_res$Method)) {
      temp2<-subset(temp1,temp1$Method==mt)
      
      all_res_ult<-rbind(all_res_ult,temp2)
    }
  }
}
all_res_ult<-all_res_ult[-1,]

# Calculate beta, OR, and 95% confidence intervals
all_res_ult$BETA<-paste(round(all_res_ult$b,3),"(",round(all_res_ult$b-1.96*all_res_ult$se,3),"-",round(all_res_ult$b+1.96*all_res_ult$se,3),")",sep = "")

all_res_ult$OR<-paste(round(exp(all_res_ult$b),3),"(",round(exp(all_res_ult$b-1.96*all_res_ult$se),3),"-",round(exp(all_res_ult$b+1.96*all_res_ult$se),3),")",sep = "")

setnames(all_res_ult,c("BETA","OR"),c("Beta (95% CI)","OR (95% CI)"))

all_res_ult$Q<-as.double(all_res_ult$Q)
all_res_ult$Q_df<-as.double(all_res_ult$Q_df)
all_res_ult$Q_pval<-as.double(all_res_ult$Q_pval)
all_res_ult$intercept<-as.double(all_res_ult$intercept)
all_res_ult$intercept_se<-as.double(all_res_ult$intercept_se)
all_res_ult$intercept_pval<-as.double(all_res_ult$intercept_pval)

write.xlsx(all_res_ult,file = file.path(mr_output_dir, "ult_har3_all_metabolite_sleep_mr_bindres_pathway_HMDBID_ulttrait.xlsx"))

temp<-subset(all_res_ult,all_res_ult$Method=="Wald ratio")
res_ult_sig<-subset(all_res_ult,all_res_ult$Method=="Inverse variance weighted")
res_ult_sig<-subset(res_ult_sig,res_ult_sig$Q_pval>0.05)
res_ult_sig<-rbind(res_ult_sig,temp)

write.xlsx(subset(res_ult_sig,res_ult_sig$pfdr_method<0.05),file = file.path(mr_output_dir, "metabolite_sleep_primary_fdrmethod0.05.xlsx"))

write.xlsx(subset(res_ult_sig,res_ult_sig$pfdr_sleepmethod<0.05),file = file.path(mr_output_dir, "metabolite_sleep_primary_fdrsleepmethod0.05.xlsx"))

write.xlsx(subset(res_ult_sig,res_ult_sig$pbof_method!="/"),file = file.path(mr_output_dir, "metabolite_sleep_primary_bofmethod0.05.xlsx"))

write.xlsx(subset(res_ult_sig,res_ult_sig$pbof_sleepmethod!="/"),file = file.path(mr_output_dir, "metabolite_sleep_primary_bofsleepmethod0.05.xlsx"))
```

## 5. Lipid sub-pathway enrichment among sleep-duration-associated metabolites

Fisher exact tests compare lipids annotated to each sub-pathway with all other panel lipids, separately for sleep duration, long sleep duration, short sleep duration, and any sleep duration.

**Chunk purpose.** Load the packages used by the Fisher tests.

```{r mr-05-01-dependencies}
# Source file: 5_Fisher_test_lipid_subpathway.R
## 0. Dependencies
pkgs <- c("readxl", "openxlsx", "ggplot2")
for (p in pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop(sprintf("Please install R package '%s' with install.packages('%s')", p, p))
  }
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(openxlsx)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

**Chunk purpose.** Define input and output locations relative to the shared project root.

```{r mr-05-02-path-configuration}
out_dir    <- file.path(base_dir, "Fisher's test")
```

**Chunk purpose.** Normalize metabolite names before annotation matching.

```{r mr-05-03-name-normalization}
# Source file: 5_Fisher_test_lipid_subpathway.R
## 2. Metabolite-name normalization
norm_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("\\[.*?\\]", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\(.*?\\)", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\*", "", x)
  x <- gsub("/", "to", x)         # /  ->  to
  x <- gsub("-", "", x)
  x <- gsub(" ", "", x)
  tolower(x)
}
norm_lower <- function(x) tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
norm_loose <- function(x) gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "", tolower(as.character(x)))
```

**Chunk purpose.** Read the significant metabolite-sleep results.

```{r mr-05-04-read-significant-results}
# Source file: 5_Fisher_test_lipid_subpathway.R
## 3. Read the significant MR results
sig_raw <- as.data.frame(read_excel(sig_file, sheet = 1))
sig_raw <- sig_raw[!is.na(sig_raw$Exposure), , drop = FALSE]

need_cols <- c("Exposure", "Super pathway", "Sub pathway", "Outcome")
miss <- setdiff(need_cols, colnames(sig_raw))
if (length(miss) > 0) stop("The significant-results table is missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
sig <- sig_raw[, need_cols]
colnames(sig) <- c("metabolite", "super_pathway", "sub_pathway", "outcome")
sig$outcome <- trimws(sig$outcome)
sig$key     <- norm_name(sig$metabolite)
sig$low     <- norm_lower(sig$metabolite)
sig$loose   <- norm_loose(sig$metabolite)
```

**Chunk purpose.** Read the full pathway annotation and define the lipid background set.

```{r mr-05-05-read-pathway-annotation}

## 4. Read the panel pathway annotation (background set)
panel <- as.data.frame(read_excel(panel_file, sheet = 1))
colnames(panel)[1:5] <- c("metabolite", "super_pathway", "sub_pathway",
                          "gene_shared_protein", "protein_names")

panel$is_ratio <- grepl("/", panel$super_pathway, fixed = TRUE)
panel$key      <- norm_name(panel$metabolite)
panel$low      <- norm_lower(panel$metabolite)
panel$loose    <- norm_loose(panel$metabolite)

bg_all <- panel[!panel$is_ratio & !is.na(panel$sub_pathway) &
                  panel$sub_pathway != "NA" & panel$super_pathway == "Lipid", ]
# bg_all <- panel[!panel$is_ratio & !is.na(panel$sub_pathway) &
#                   panel$sub_pathway != "NA", ]
bg_all <- bg_all[, c("metabolite", "key", "low", "loose",
                     "super_pathway", "sub_pathway")]
rownames(bg_all) <- NULL

cat("Background set: panel lipid metabolites =", nrow(bg_all), "; number of sub-pathways =",
    length(unique(bg_all$sub_pathway)), "\n")
cat("Significant-results table:", nrow(sig), " metabolite-sleep pairs; lipid pairs =",
    sum(sig$super_pathway == "Lipid"), " pairs /",
    length(unique(sig$metabolite[sig$super_pathway == "Lipid"])), " metabolites\n")
```

**Chunk purpose.** Map significant lipids to the background annotation with strict-to-loose name matching.

```{r mr-05-06-map-metabolites}
# Source file: 5_Fisher_test_lipid_subpathway.R
## 5. Map significant metabolites to background lipid rows
map_sig_to_bg <- function(sig_lipids, bg) {
  idx <- integer(nrow(sig_lipids))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sig_lipids))) {
    lw <- sig_lipids$low[i]
    ky <- sig_lipids$key[i]
    sb <- sig_lipids$sub_pathway[i]

    hit <- which(bg$low == lw)
    if (length(hit) == 0) hit <- which(bg$key == ky)
    if (length(hit) > 1) {
      hit2 <- hit[bg$sub_pathway[hit] == sb]
      if (length(hit2) >= 1) hit <- hit2
    }
    if (length(hit) == 0) {
      warning("A significant metabolite was not found in the background annotation: ", sig_lipids$metabolite[i])
      idx[i] <- NA_integer_
    } else {
      if (length(hit) > 1)
        warning("A significant metabolite matched multiple background rows; the first was used: ",
                sig_lipids$metabolite[i])
      idx[i] <- hit[1]
    }
  }
  idx
}
```

**Chunk purpose.** Define sleep-duration outcomes, including their union.

```{r mr-05-07-outcome-sets}
# Source file: 5_Fisher_test_lipid_subpathway.R
## 6. Define the four outcome sets
outcome_defs <- list(
  "Sleep duration"       = c("Sleep duration"),
  "Long sleep duration"  = c("Long sleep duration"),
  "Short sleep duration" = c("Short sleep duration"),
  "Any sleep duration"   = c("Sleep duration", "Long sleep duration", "Short sleep duration")
)
```

**Chunk purpose.** Build 2 x 2 tables and run one-sided and two-sided Fisher exact tests.

```{r mr-05-08-fisher-function}
# Source file: 5_Fisher_test_lipid_subpathway.R
## 7. Core Fisher exact-test function
# bg      : background data.frame (key / sub_pathway)
run_fisher_lipid <- function(bg, is_sig, label) {

  n_total <- nrow(bg)
  n_sig   <- sum(is_sig)

  subs <- sort(unique(bg$sub_pathway))

  res <- lapply(subs, function(s) {
    inS <- bg$sub_pathway == s
    a  <- sum( inS &  is_sig)
    b  <- sum( inS & !is_sig)
    cc <- sum(!inS &  is_sig)
    d  <- sum(!inS & !is_sig)

    m <- matrix(c(a, b, cc, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                dimnames = list(c("in_subpathway", "other_lipids"),
                                c("associated", "not_associated")))

    ft_g <- fisher.test(m, alternative = "greater")
    ft_2 <- fisher.test(m, alternative = "two.sided", conf.int = TRUE)

    exp_a <- (a + b) * (a + cc) / n_total

    data.frame(
      Outcome                    = label,
      Sub_pathway                = s,
      N_lipids_in_subpathway     = a + b,
      a_Sig_in_subpathway        = a,
      b_NonSig_in_subpathway     = b,
      c_Sig_other_lipids         = cc,
      d_NonSig_other_lipids      = d,
      N_lipids_total             = n_total,
      N_lipids_significant_total = n_sig,
      Pct_sig_in_subpathway      = ifelse((a + b) > 0, 100 * a / (a + b), NA_real_),
      Pct_sig_other_lipids       = ifelse((cc + d) > 0, 100 * cc / (cc + d), NA_real_),
      Expected_a                 = exp_a,
      Fold_enrichment            = ifelse(exp_a > 0, a / exp_a, NA_real_),
      OR_sample                  = ifelse(b * cc > 0, (a * d) / (b * cc), NA_real_),
      OR_conditional_MLE         = unname(ft_2$estimate),
      OR_CI_low                  = unname(ft_2$conf.int[1]),
      OR_CI_high                 = unname(ft_2$conf.int[2]),
      P_one_sided_greater        = ft_g$p.value,
      P_two_sided                = ft_2$p.value,
      stringsAsFactors           = FALSE
    )
  })

  out <- do.call(rbind, res)

  out$FDR_BH <- p.adjust(out$P_one_sided_greater, method = "BH")
  out$Holm   <- p.adjust(out$P_one_sided_greater, method = "holm")
  out$FDR_significant_0.05 <- out$FDR_BH < 0.05
  out$FDR_BH_two_sided      <- p.adjust(out$P_two_sided, method = "BH")
  out$Holm_two_sided        <- p.adjust(out$P_two_sided, method = "holm")
  out$FDR_two_sided_sig_0.05 <- out$FDR_BH_two_sided < 0.05

  out <- out[order(out$P_one_sided_greater), ]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}
```

**Chunk purpose.** Run Fisher tests for every outcome and show progress.

```{r mr-05-09-run-tests}
# Source file: 5_Fisher_test_lipid_subpathway.R
## 8. Build 2 x 2 tables and run Fisher tests by outcome
results_list  <- list()
is_sig_list   <- list()
subclass_cnt  <- list()

for (nm in names(outcome_defs)) {
  sl <- unique(sig[sig$super_pathway == "Lipid" & sig$outcome %in% outcome_defs[[nm]],
                   c("metabolite", "key", "low", "sub_pathway")])

  idx <- map_sig_to_bg(sl, bg_all)
  sl  <- sl[!is.na(idx), , drop = FALSE]
  idx <- idx[!is.na(idx)]

  is_sig <- rep(FALSE, nrow(bg_all))
  is_sig[idx] <- TRUE

  chk <- data.frame(sub_pathway = bg_all$sub_pathway, sig = is_sig)
  tab <- aggregate(sig ~ sub_pathway, data = chk, FUN = function(z) c(a = sum(z), n = length(z)))
  a_col <- tab$sig[, "a"]; n_col <- tab$sig[, "n"]
  if (any(a_col > n_col)) {
    warning(nm, ": A sub-pathway has more significant metabolites than background metabolites; check the annotation.")
  }

  results_list[[nm]] <- run_fisher_lipid(bg_all, is_sig, nm)
  is_sig_list[[nm]]  <- is_sig
  subclass_cnt[[nm]] <- data.frame(Outcome = nm, Sub_pathway = tab$sub_pathway,
                                   a = as.integer(a_col), N = as.integer(n_col),
                                   b = as.integer(n_col - a_col),
                                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  cat(sprintf("[Primary analysis] %-22s significant lipids = %3d / %3d\n", nm, sum(is_sig), nrow(bg_all)))
}

all_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
rownames(all_results) <- NULL
```

**Chunk purpose.** Repeat the analysis with MR-testable lipids as a sensitivity background.

```{r mr-05-10-sensitivity-analysis}
# Source file: 5_Fisher_test_lipid_subpathway.R
## 9. Sensitivity analysis using estimable lipids as background
sens_results <- NULL
if (file.exists(allMR_file)) {
  mr_all    <- as.data.frame(read_excel(allMR_file, sheet = 1))
  mr_names  <- unique(c(mr_all$reportedTrait, mr_all$ult_trait))
  mr_key    <- unique(norm_name(mr_names))
  mr_loose  <- unique(norm_loose(mr_names))
  tested    <- bg_all$key %in% mr_key | bg_all$loose %in% mr_loose
  bg_tested <- bg_all[tested, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(bg_tested) <- NULL

  cat("\nSensitivity-analysis background: lipids with an MR estimate =", nrow(bg_tested), "\n")
  sens_list <- list()
  for (nm in names(outcome_defs)) {
    sens_list[[nm]] <- run_fisher_lipid(bg_tested, is_sig_list[[nm]][tested],
                                        paste0(nm, " [tested background]"))
  }
  sens_results <- do.call(rbind, sens_list)
  rownames(sens_results) <- NULL
}
```

```{r mr-05-12-write-results}
notes <- data.frame(Note = c(
  "Fisher's exact test for enrichment of lipid sub-pathways among sleep-duration-associated metabolites",
  "2 x 2 table: rows = [lipids annotated to the sub-pathway, all other lipids]; columns = [associated with the sleep-duration trait, not associated]",
  "a = sub-pathway lipids associated; b = sub-pathway lipids not associated; c = other lipids associated; d = other lipids not associated",
  "P_one_sided_greater = Fisher's exact test with alternative = 'greater' (enrichment test); P_two_sided = two-sided Fisher's exact test",
  "OR_conditional_MLE / OR_CI_low / OR_CI_high = conditional maximum-likelihood odds ratio and exact 95% CI from fisher.test",
  "OR_sample = crude odds ratio (a*d)/(b*c)",
  "FDR_BH / Holm = BH-FDR and Holm correction based on the ONE-SIDED p-value (P_one_sided_greater) across all lipid sub-pathways within each outcome; this is the primary result",
  "FDR_BH_two_sided / Holm_two_sided = the same corrections applied to the TWO-SIDED p-value (provided for comparison / sensitivity)",
  paste0("Background (main analysis) = all ", nrow(bg_all),
         " single lipid metabolites of the Metabolon panel (super pathway = Lipid); metabolite ratios (A/B) excluded; each lipid counted once"),
  "Background (sensitivity analysis) = only lipids for which an MR estimate was available",
  "Significant metabolite-sleep pairs were taken from MR_Significant_MetaboliteSleep.xlsx (PFDR < 0.05, primary IVW analysis, correct causal direction)",
  "'Any sleep duration' = union of Sleep duration, Long sleep duration and Short sleep duration",
  "Method: Fisher exact tests for lipid sub-pathway enrichment"
))
addWorksheet(wb, "Methods")
writeData(wb, "Methods", notes)
setColWidths(wb, "Methods", cols = 1, widths = 160)

can_write <- function(p) {
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(TRUE)
  con <- try(file(p, "r+b"), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(con, "try-error")) return(FALSE)
  close(con); TRUE
}

xlsx_out <- file.path(out_dir, "Fisher_lipid_subpathway_results.xlsx")
if (!can_write(xlsx_out)) {
  xlsx_out <- file.path(out_dir,
    format(Sys.time(), "Fisher_lipid_subpathway_results_%H%M%S.xlsx"))
  cat("\nNote: the target xlsx is locked by another program (usually Excel); output was written to: ", xlsx_out, "\n")
}
saveWorkbook(wb, xlsx_out, overwrite = TRUE)
cat("\nWritten: ", xlsx_out, "\n")
```
